name: The policy, end to end
caption: Each observed frame becomes one joint state–action token. One causal context Transformer reads 256 of them; its state for the current frame feeds one causal action decoder, which writes the next controller frames one at a time, and the game plays the first two before the next plan. Select a stage to open it.

name: Where a predicted action may look
caption: Three generations of the decoder, drawn as dependency wires. Every predicted action reads the trunk state, which itself reads earlier frames. Independent multi-token prediction adds more actions but no wires between them. The autoregressive decoder adds the two remaining families: each action reads the actions before it, and inside a frame each controller group reads the groups already chosen.

name: Three paths into the action logits
caption: O43 arm A feeds the action logits three ways: the temporal decoder’s future-frame state, conditioned within the frame by FiLM and read by a SiLU MLP head, plus a direct skip from the trunk state. Removing any one of them cost stocks on both evaluation suites; hover a row to see the path it removed.

name: Run-length action spans
caption: O18 packed the four controller groups into one symbol per frame and let BPE merge repeated holds into span tokens of up to 16 frames. The compression was real; executing a token to completion was not, and the package lost 2.6 stocks per minute.
